2. Template 1914396 further disconnected the sulfonyl‑aryl‑cinnamic acid into a sulfonyl‑aryl‑aldehyde and malonic acid.  
3. Template 733 will now be applied to the sulfonyl‑aryl‑aldehyde fragment to break the sulfonyl‑aryl bond, yielding simple, commercially available building blocks.
